contract.name: Gus
contract.reason: Raiders keep stealing from the farm wagons.
contract.title: Supplies for Briar

patrol.text: Defeat 10 farm raiders or Legion hex casters at the western supply wagon. Keep the supplies safe for Briar.
patrol.title: Drive back the farm raiders

groups.intent: Read the first raider before reaching the mill.
Cross the repaired mill bridge into a guard and rear caster.
Finite guards defend the departure road, not the village.

contract.name: Lewis
contract.reason: Search parties keep coming through the woods.
contract.target: Legion shield guard / Legion runner / Legion spellcaster
contract.title: Keep the escape route clear

patrol.text: Cut down the patrols searching for the fleeing villagers. Defeat 12 Legion searchers at the forest signal path.
patrol.title: Guard the forest route

groups.intent: A front searcher, flanker and rear hex caster hold the signal approach.
Ground guards remain below the climb; upper-route players are not detected through floors.
Rescue predators remain at Beth’s brother, away from the safe path.

contract.name: Caleb
contract.reason: Travelers need a clear path through these hunting grounds.
contract.title: Safe passage

patrol.text: Keep these dangerous hunting grounds clear for travelers. Defeat 10 cliff predators at the lower cliff paths.
patrol.title: Clear the cliff paths

groups.intent: Predators defend the lower path; the spitter stays behind the first pair.
Finite freight guards hold the crossing exit with a rear caster.

contract.name: Ruth
contract.reason: The freed prisoners need room to recover.
contract.title: A safer shelter

patrol.text: Keep these dangerous hunting grounds clear for travelers. Defeat 12 canyon predators at the hidden canyon floor.
patrol.title: Cover the rescued travelers

groups.intent: A guard screens the caster at the first cage.
Two defenders cover the north cage without chasing back to the entrance.
The optional prisoner has an independent guard pair.

contract.name: Grant
contract.reason: The siege troops keep returning to the old bell tower yard.
contract.target: Legion shield guard / Legion spellcaster / Legion runner
contract.title: Break the siege patrol

patrol.text: Drive the Legion away from the Keep workshops. Defeat 10 Legion siege troops at the old bell tower yard.
patrol.title: Break the siege patrol

groups.intent: The gallery caster remains above the breached gate, supported by a guard.
A workshop sentry guards the approach to the tool route.
A front guard and rear hex caster defend the key.
Keep the repeatable siege camp together, separate from the rescue waves.

contract.name: Walter
contract.reason: Search troops are using the lower works to reach the prisoners.
contract.target: Legion shield guard / Legion spellcaster / Legion runner
contract.title: Keep the works clear

patrol.text: Clear the patrols hunting the freed prisoners. Defeat 12 prison search troops at the lower prison works.
patrol.title: Protect the prison exit

groups.intent: Finite cell guards defend the prisoner, not the lower floor.
The caster supports the knight only on the upper landing.
Separate drain fights leave the main evacuation route readable.
Hunting troops stay on their own lower floor.

contract.name: Heath
contract.reason: Mountain threats keep gathering near the lift house.
contract.target: Legion shield guard / Legion runner / Legion spellcaster
contract.title: Keep the shelter route open

patrol.text: Clear hostile creatures and patrols around the climb. Defeat 10 Legion mountain troops at the mountain lift house.
patrol.title: Secure the mountain camps

groups.intent: Space the opening creatures along the first climb instead of one pile.
The mountain patrol defends the lift house and its supplies.
The summit has a screening pair and a rear frost caller.

contract.name: Professor Ellis
contract.reason: The search troops took my sealed field samples.
contract.title: Recover the samples

patrol.text: Thin the enemies that could follow Ellis out of the mountain. Defeat 12 Legion searchers at the cave waterworks.
patrol.title: Protect the escape from the caves

groups.intent: Two creatures pressure consecutive turns before the first pages.
Finite rescue guards remain around Ellis’s cell.
A guard screens the crossing caster; no detection from the channel above.

contract.name: Flint
contract.reason: The weapon-line guards carry scraps I can use for repairs.
contract.title: Metal worth saving

patrol.text: Defeat the Legion troops guarding its weapon supply. Defeat 10 forge guards at the weapon-line drive floor.
patrol.title: Disrupt the weapon crews

groups.intent: Finite guards hold the workers’ approach, with the caster behind.
The west guard covers the route into the handle workshop.
A screening pair and cinder caller defend the mold drive.
The last guard challenges the exit approach after the machinery.

contract.name: Martin
contract.reason: Furnace patrols keep returning to the worker floor.
contract.title: Keep the worker floor clear

patrol.text: Stop the troops protecting the furnace while the workers escape. Defeat 12 furnace patrol at the furnace worker floor.
patrol.title: Cut off furnace support

groups.intent: Repeatable guards defend the worker district independently of the escort.
The gallery pair remains on its walkway, away from the animal rescue.
Finite office guards remain at the writings, on the upper floor.

contract.name: Otto
contract.reason: Wreck raiders keep taking the supplies we need for repairs.
contract.target: Legion shield guard / Legion spellcaster / Legion runner
contract.title: Protect the salvage

patrol.text: Clear the raiders and creatures around the wrecks. Defeat 10 wreck raiders at the upper shipwreck.
patrol.title: Secure the crossing supplies

groups.intent: The western wreck caster covers the approach to the rudder.
A guard, flanker and tide caster defend the upper sail wreck.
The shore guard screens the branch to the memorial.

contract.name: Abe
contract.reason: The tide slimes are spreading across the fishing pools.
contract.title: Clear the tide pools

patrol.text: Clear the tide pools below the climb. Defeat 12 tide slimes at the lower tide pools.
patrol.title: Keep the cliff landing safe

groups.intent: A guard occupies the first landing, a caster the next turn.
Separate successive landings instead of dragging the whole climb behind the player.
A guard screens the final tide caster before the hydra approach.

contract.name: Sister Grace
contract.reason: The wounded need the western garden kept clear.
contract.title: Room to recover

patrol.text: Break the patrols holding the palace courtyards. Defeat 10 Legion garden patrol at the western palace garden.
patrol.title: Reclaim the palace grounds

groups.intent: Finite west guards protect the upper route, not the garden below.
Finite east guards protect the opposing upper route.
The garden patrol is its own fight, with a clear screening guard.
The last arcanist holds the climb before the mirror court.

contract.name: Master Hugh
contract.reason: The patrols in the display hall threaten the books.
contract.title: Protect the collection

patrol.text: Clear the Legion troops threatening the rescued scholars. Defeat 12 library patrol at the sealed display hall.
patrol.title: Protect the library halls

groups.intent: Separate maintenance and records sentries preserve a choice of approach.
Finite main-hall guards hold the release route.
The optional display patrol stays in the display wing.
A final sentry covers the release-room approach.

contract.name: Roland
contract.reason: The west approach is watched by a returning patrol.
contract.title: Thin the castle patrol

patrol.text: Reduce the forces watching the castle approach. Defeat 10 castle patrol at the western castle approach.
patrol.title: Weaken the castle patrols

groups.intent: Finite supply guards defend the disguise supplies; preserve alternate access.
A front guard screens the royal arcanist at the helmet route.
The optional store has an independent guard/caster pair.
The arcanist holds the final approach without pursuing into the supply ward.

contract.name: Miles
contract.reason: Reinforcements keep arriving on the first high landing.
contract.target: Legion siege knight / Legion arcanist / Legion shield guard
contract.title: Keep the landing clear

patrol.text: Defeat the guards that could trap the rescued workers below. Defeat 12 tower reinforcements at the first high tower landing.
patrol.title: Clear the tower behind you

groups.intent: The first pair only sees the player once they reach its landing.
The knight and caster own the lower-bars landing, not the floor below.
Cell guards remain on the prisoner landing.
The midpoint guard screens its arcanist.
The upper east pair stays on its own storey.
The second knight and caster defend the upper bars.
The final formation defends the summit, independently of lower-storey fights.
